turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good morning, this is Anna from the plant. You asked about the 40 mm profile last week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. Honestly we got a quote from another supplier and it is cheaper by about eight percent.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: On price, the difference is the coating. Ours is galvanised on both sides, theirs is one side, which is why the eight percent.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, but who signs this on your side is not my problem. I need it by the twentieth.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood. Who approves the purchase on your side, you or the plant director?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The director. Send the offer by Thursday and I will sign on Friday.
